description: This source file contains a fuzzing test for the Qpack encoder and decoder in the QUIC protocol implementation, including classes for encoding, decoding, and transmitting header blocks with simulated delays, as well as functions for generating and splitting header lists based on fuzz data.

classes.name: EncodingEndpoint
classes.description: Manages a QpackEncoder instance and its error delegate, providing methods to encode header lists and set delegate.

classes.name: DelayedHeaderBlockTransmitter
classes.description: Simulates transmission of header blocks with delays, queuing encoded headers and transmitting parts based on fuzz data.

classes.name: VerifyingDecoder
classes.description: Decodes header blocks, verifies correctness against expected headers, and manages asynchronous decoding context.

classes.name: DecodingEndpoint
classes.description: Manages a QpackDecoder, expected header lists, and VerifyingDecoders, coordinating header decoding and verification.

classes.name: DelayedStreamDataTransmitter
classes.description: Buffers and transmits stream data (encoder/decoder streams) with delays, simulating network conditions.

methods.name: TruncateValueOnInvalidChars
methods.description: Removes invalid characters (NUL, LF, CR) from a string.

methods.name: GenerateHeaderList
methods.description: Creates a header list with randomized headers based on fuzz data.

methods.name: SplitHeaderList
methods.description:
Splits header values along '
' or ';' separators into multiple headers.
